Na seriji MR presjeka desnog koljena nalazi se uredna morfologija i intenziteti signala lateralnog
kolateralnog ligmanta, prednjeg i stražnjeg križnog ligamenta, iliotibijalnog traktusa, patelarnog
ligamenta. Diskretno je povišen intenzitet signala hvatišta tetive m. kvadricepsa što dif. dg.
odgovara početnim entezopatskim promjenama.
Lezija I. stupnja MCL prvenstveno u sklopu degenerativnih promjena.
Sitna cistična degenerativna promjena na mjestu insercije prednjeg križnog ligamenta za tibiju.
Medijalni i lateralni menisk uredne su morfologije i intenziteta signala.
Patela je medioponirana (Wiberg 2). Reducirana je debljina artikulacijske hrskavice
femoropatelarnog zgloba uz vidljivu fissuru lateralne trohleje femura (hondromalacija II./III.
stupnja).
Heterogen je intenzitet signala lateralne fasete patele (hondromalacija II. stupnja).
Reducirana je debljina artikulacijske hrskavice femorotibijalnog zgloba, naglašenije medijalnog
kompartmenta gdje je vidljiva hondromalacija II. stupnja medijalnog platoa tibije i kondila
femura.
Ne nalazi se poplitealne (Bakerove) ciste.
Supkutani edem prepatelarno i opsežnije infrapatelarno.
Cistična lezija posteromedijalnog dijela proksimalne metafize tibije aksijalno dimenzija oko 6 x 3
mm.
Ostale prikazane koštane, mekotkivne i neurovaskularne strukture uredne su morfologije i
intenziteta signala.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Gonalgia anterior derecha.
Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones de señal significativas de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
Aumento de señal central del cuerno posterior y parte del cuerpo del menisco medial que no
impresiona contactar con la superficie articular, sin caracteres propios de rotura. El menisco lateral
es de morfología y señal conservada, sin signos de rotura.
Cartílagos de los compartimentos femorotibiales con condropatía superficial difusa.
Cartílago troclear sin alteraciones. Úlceras condrales de espesor total con cambios óseos
secundarios la faceta lateral y vértice de la rótula.
Leve aumento de señal del aspecto superoexterno de la grasa de Hoffa.
Mínimo derrame articular. No hay quistes poplíteos patológicos.
Tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de límites normales.
Leve aumento de señal de la inserción distal del tendón cuadricipital y de la inserción proximal del
tendón rotuliano, sin signos de rotura.
Impresión:
Condropatía con lesiones grado 4 de la rótula. Condropatía superficial de la zona de carga de los
compartimentos femorotibiales.
Discretos signos de un síndrome de hiperpresión externa de la rótula.
Mínimo derrame articular.
Leve tendinosis rotuliana proximal y cuadricipital distal

Diz eklemi içi sıvı miktarı normal. Ön çapraz bağdaki mukoid dejenerasyon femoral ve tibyal yapışma yerleri komşuluğundaki intraoseöz milimetrik boyuttaki kistik uzanımlarla birlikte. Arka çapraz ve dış yan bağ normal. Lateral menisküs arka boynuz-gövdesi bileşkesindeki dejeneratif yapı içi intensite artışına yırtık eşlik etmiyor. Medyal menisküs arka kök-boynuzundan gövdesine kadar uzanan yaygın dejenerasyon üst ve alt eklem yüzeylerindeki düzensizlik ve üst eklem yüzeyi ile ilişkilenen vertikal oblik yırtıkla birlikte (kompleks yırtığı ile uyumlu). Medyal menisküs medyale 7 mm ekstrüde olup iç yan bağı basılıyor. İç yan bağın çevresi, meniskofemoral ve meniskotibyal bağlar ödemli. Troklear sulkus hipoplazik olup sulkus açısı 154 derece. Patella laterale 4 mm translasyon gösteriyor. Patellanın yüksekliği normal. Hoffanın yağ yastıkçığı ödemli. Ekstansör mekanizma bunun dışında korunmuş. Dizin anteriorunda, derin cilt altı bağ dokusu ödemli. Eklem kıkırdakları ve kemikler bunların dışında normal. Proksimal tibyofibular eklem normal.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Policontusiones.
Hallazgos:
No hay alteración de señal difusa de la médula ósea.
Focos de edema óseo post contusionales en el aspecto postero central del platillo tibial medial y
aspecto posterior del platillo tibial lateral y extremo proximal del peroné. Se asocia a edema,
aumento de señal y disrupción parcial de las fibras del ligamento tibioperoneo anterior.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales continuos.
Menisco medial de morfología y señal conservada, sin criterios categóricos de rotura.
Menisco lateral de morfología y señal conservados.
Cartílago femorotibial de espesor y señal conservados con irregularidad superficial en el tercio
medio de la superficie de carga del cóndilo medial y platillo tibial ipsilateral cercano a la región
intercondílea y en el aspecto posterior de carga de ambos cóndilos femorales.
Cartílago rotuliano con discreta irregularidad superficial en el vértice de la patela. Cartílago troclear
de espesor y señal conservados. Engrosamiento con alteración de señal del tendón rotuliano
proximal.
Restantes tendones regionales de espesor y señal conservados.
Leve derrame articular. No se observa quiste de Baker.
Planos musculares de trofismo y señal conservados.
Impresión:
Focos de contusión ósea en sitios descritos asociado a esguince grado I-II del ligamento
tibioperoneo anterior.
Condropatía femorotibial superficial.
Condropatía rotuliana superficial.
Tendinopatía rotuliana proximal.
Leve derrame articular

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Anterior right knee pain. 
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.  

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES: 
Bone marrow edema identified in the patella which appears related to full-thickness chondrosis. There are tricompartment marginal osteophytes. 
Alignment is anatomic.  No aggressive osseous lesions.  

JOINT SPACE: 
Intra-articular body deep to the posterior root of the medial meniscus. Small joint effusion. No Baker's cyst. 

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Extensive complex tear of the meniscus with partial tearing of the posterior root, maceration of the posterior horn, and undersurface tearing body. 
Medial compartment cartilage: Full-thickness cartilage loss posterior weightbearing portion of the femoral condyle. Button osteophyte/articular spur of the femoral condyle. 

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Diffuse intrasubstance degeneration with no tear. 
Lateral compartment cartilage: Small areas of full-thickness cartilage loss on both sides of the joint. Button osteophyte/articular spur of the femoral condyle. 

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT: 
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Denudation of cartilage of the lateral patellar facet and median ridge. Full thickness cartilage loss of the lateral trochlea. Heterogeneity of the medial patellar facet and medial trochlea cartilage. 

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.  
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.  

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal. 
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.  
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal. 

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.  
Patellofemoral tracking: Increased tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 23 mm. Mild edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. 
No lateral patellar tilt or translation.  No patella alta.  Normal patellar and trochlear morphology.  

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy.  Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact. 

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle. 

IMPRESSION:
1.	Tricompartment osteoarthritis including marginal osteophytes, chondrosis and bone marrow edema in the patella.
2.	Extensive complex medial meniscus tear with full-thickness cartilage loss in the medial tibiofemoral compartment.
3.	Increased tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG).

МР находка: Костите, формиращи колянната става са с нормална форма и сигнална характеристика. Няма данни за ставен излив. Артикулиращия хрущял на фемура и тибията е съхранен. МР данни за лезия на задния рог на медиалния менискус. Визуализира се хиперинтензна линия с радиерен ход в менискуса, която достига ставната повърхност на тибията.
